experiment_name: Self-play training-plumbing smoke, genuinely ASU-import-free (own wiring, no adapters/arena/training import)

algorithm_config.fix_under_test: scripts/selfplay_train_smoke.py rewritten to import only monopoly_bench.engine/.model/.search/.storage/.config/.contracts and monopoly_game_engine.agents_fixed - never monopoly_bench.adapters, .arena, or .training, which import ASU_FROZEN_TEACHER at module level (adapters.py, training.py) or transitively (arena.py imports adapters.py)
own_wiring: LocalSearchPolicy: thin wrapper around MaxNPUCT (search.py has zero ASU references)

LocalFixedPolicy: reimplements FixedAdapter's observed behavior (decision_seed isolation via random.seed/setstate, illegal-action fallback substitution) using only FP_AGENT_CLASSES and engine.unwrap/ActionType
play_local_game: own game loop (turn iteration, legal-action check, fail-closed on illegal/crash, position recording) built from SharedGame/legal_mask/terminal_value, not copied from arena.play_game

local_training_update: own training-step function (MCTS visit-count policy loss + real-winner value loss via actor_order reordering) built from ReplayBuffer's sample() contract, not copied from training.train_step
algorithm_config.runtime_guard: sys.modules checked for ASU_FROZEN_TEACHER (or any submodule) at the end of the run; the run fails if any are present

metrics.matches_prior_asu_coupled_implementation: yes - same seed, same numbers (709 positions, winners 1/3/3, same four loss values, 16/16 params changed) as docs/baseline_runs/selfplay_repro_run1.json (the last run of the previous, ASU-import-coupled implementation), confirming this reimplementation is behaviorally equivalent, not just import-cleaner

result: Genuinely ASU-import-free: asu_modules_loaded was [] (count 0) in both runs, verified by the script's own end-of-run sys.modules check (which would raise if any ASU_FROZEN_TEACHER module were present). All plumbing checks passed: positions_collected_total 709 > 0, loss finite, 16/16 parameters changed, 0 illegal actions, 0 crashes, fixed-agent fallbacks genuinely measured (0/0/0 for fixed-a/b/c, not assumed). REPRODUCIBILITY PASSED across two independent runs: diff excluding elapsed_s/peak_rss_gib was empty. Results are numerically identical to the prior ASU-import-coupled implementation's last run, confirming the own-wiring reimplementation preserves behavior while removing the import-time ASU dependency.
notes: Supersedes 010's and 011's ASU-independence framing (see their notes fields for the correction, not deleted): ASU output/teacher was never used in any of 010/011/012, but 010 and 011 ran a version of the script that still loaded ASU_FROZEN_TEACHER into sys.modules as an import-time side effect via monopoly_bench.adapters/arena/training. This entry (012) is the first one where sys.modules was actually checked and confirmed empty of ASU. Decision to do this rewrite logged in docs/DECISIONS.md.
